name: X-linked intellectual disability-seizures-psoriasis syndrome
aliases: X-linked ID with epilepsy and psoriasis

criteria.description: Presence of moderate to severe intellectual disability
Recurrent generalized or focal seizures beginning in early childhood
Chronic plaque psoriasis with typical dermatological features
X-linked inheritance pattern with affected males in multiple generations
Identification of pathogenic variant in the implicated X-linked gene

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of intellectual disability, seizures, and psoriasis in a male patient with suggestive family history or genetic confirmation
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is clinical but supported by genetic testing when available.

laboratory: Elevated inflammatory markers during psoriatic flares
imaging: Brain MRI may show nonspecific cerebral atrophy or be normal
genetic: Pathogenic variants in an X-linked gene associated with intellectual disability and psoriasis (specific gene not fully characterized)
other: Electroencephalogram (EEG) showing epileptiform discharges consistent with seizure type

distinguishingFeatures: Variable seizure types without dermatological involvement
Psoriasis present but intellectual disability is mild or absent

redFlags: Early onset of seizures refractory to standard antiepileptic drugs
Rapid progression or worsening of psoriatic skin lesions with systemic symptoms
references: Orphanet: X-linked intellectual disability-seizures-psoriasis syndrome, ORPHA:3052
Recent case reports and reviews on X-linked syndromic intellectual disability with dermatological manifestations
